data.one_liner: A command-line interface for the Vyuh Framework to scaffold modular Flutter Apps and features.
data.what_it_does: Provides a CLI to scaffold modular Flutter applications, portable features, shared capability plugins, and optional CMS schemas using the Vyuh Framework. It includes diagnostic tooling with the doctor command and local workspace bootstrap capabilities.
use_when: You are building applications using the Vyuh Framework
You need to quickly scaffold modular Flutter project workspaces, features, and plugins
You require optional Sanity CMS integration with local studio setups
avoid_when: You are not using the Vyuh Framework in your project
You are building a standard application without modular workspace architectures
strengths: Streamlines the creation of modular Flutter apps, features, and plugins
Includes built-in diagnostic tooling via the doctor command
Supports optional CMS integration with sanity
weaknesses: Strictly tied to the Vyuh Framework ecosystem
Requires external tools like Node/pnpm and Sanity account access if using CMS integration
data.setup_notes: Install globally via 'dart pub global activate vyuh_cli'. Ensure Flutter and Dart are on your PATH.
data.minimal_example:
dart pub global activate vyuh_cli
vyuh create project shop --org-name=com.acme --platforms=android,ios,web -o products
